dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Earliest deal date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to start from today.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Latest deal date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for 30 days after the start date. The range is capped at 12 months.

statuses.title: Deal statuses
statuses.description: Which stages to return. Filed deals are the earliest signal, often months before a company prices.

tickers.title: Ticker watchlist
tickers.description: Only return these proposed symbols. Leave empty to get every deal in the date range.

minDealValueUsd.title: Minimum deal value (USD)
minDealValueUsd.description: Skip deals raising less than this, for example 50000000 for 50 million. Deals with no published value are skipped when this is set. Leave empty for no filter.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new deals only
newOnly.description: Remember deals already returned and emit only ones not seen before. A deal reappears when it changes stage, so a filing that later prices is reported again. Run on a daily schedule for a clean feed. Quiet runs cost nothing.
